**1. Monthly Bedrock cost (ending 7339, unblended)**

| Service | Sep | Oct | Nov 1–24 |
|---|---|---|---|

- Model-token spend alone, excluding AgentCore, was about $80.35 in October and about $0.78 in November so far.

**2. Top contributors in October, by usage type**
- **Claude Sonnet 5 (`anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-mantle`, standard, us-east-1): $51.56, or 64% of model spend.**
  - Input tokens were $27.00 (12,687 units).

- **AgentCore Runtime.** Check that the 26–27 Oct sessions had no idle or stuck runtimes consuming vCPU. Add session timeouts.
- **Governance.** Set an AWS Budget or Cost Anomaly Detection monitor on the Bedrock services.
- **Provisioned throughput.** There was none, so there is nothing to right-size.

1. Check the payer account (ending 2075) or other member accounts in Cost Explorer. The "doubling" is probably there, so confirm which account holds the bill.
